name: TELMISARTAN/AMLODIPINE 80MG/5MG 28 CAPSULES
description: The combination of telmisartan and amlodipine is used to treat high blood pressure (essential hypertension). Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor antagonist, which helps relax blood vessels, while amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker, which also helps relax blood vessels. Combining them can achieve a greater reduction in blood pressure than either drug alone. Antihypertensive. A prescription is required. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
